title: Optimize IN list index scan allocation
constraints: Preserve primary-key and secondary-index IN list semantics
rationale: The IN list index scan path collects row ids from a known list length and, for secondary indexes, from already materialized scan_prefix candidates. Preallocating the row id HashSet from those counts reduces rehash and allocation churn.
steps: Preallocate IN list row id set from IN list length
Reserve secondary-index candidate count after each scan_prefix
Add a secondary-index IN list integration assertion
Verify primary and secondary index IN list behavior
expected_impact: Reduces allocation churn in indexed IN list scans without changing scan semantics.
